title: Representative normalization of lisse coefficient extension
statement: For normalized realizations over finite fields $E\to F$ [def-real-lisse-realization-data], require the coefficient ring square to commute. Identify the recorded ordinary completed scalar extension with ordinary change of rings by the map sending $c\otimes m$ to $c\otimes m$; fix the corresponding derived comparison by its universal counit. On each integral constructible object invert the specified completion map $\chi$ [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison], extend to rational coefficients, and use the canonical derived scalar associators to obtain the comparison with rational field extension. Require the lisse comparison to be its degree-zero map, using the exact ordinary field-extension functor and a homology-normalized degree-zero identification.
